name: merit

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p scripts/demo && tsc -p e2e
scripts.//typecheck: `pnpm -r` walks the WORKSPACE, and scripts/demo is deliberately not a package in it. So the demo's project is named here: a TypeScript directory no `tsc` invocation reaches is a directory that rots, and the alternative (making a demo a workspace package) spends a VG-12 admission on a script that prints a table. `e2e` is named for the SAME reason and it additionally OWNS the two apps' e2e directories: their spec files import the pass, whose browser-side half needs the DOM lib that tsconfig.base.json deliberately withholds from every Node deployable, so one project typechecks the pass end to end and neither app tsconfig is widened.
scripts.//e2e: CI-08, the slop-score pass. NOT part of `verify`, on the rule `falsify:ci` states one line down: a check that cannot run is not a check that passed. This one needs a Chromium binary, which is a download rather than a workspace install, so folding it into `verify` would make the local gate unrunnable on a laptop that has not run `playwright install chromium`. CI runs it as its own stage.
scripts.//falsify:ci: The CI-01, CI-02 and CI-05 gates watched failing on a seeded violation. NOT part of `verify`, and the reason is the one repo-invariants.mjs states: a check that cannot run is not a check that passed. Three of its cases need gitleaks, syft and grype, so folding it into `verify` would make the local gate unrunnable on a laptop that has not installed four scanners. CI runs it per stage (`falsify-ci.mjs CI-01`), where they are all pinned and present.
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:invariants && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run gates && pnpm run falsify

//pnpm.overrides: ONE OVERRIDE, AND IT EXISTS BECAUSE THE STRYKER ADMISSION FAILED `CI-05` BEFORE IT PASSED ANYTHING. `@stryker-mutator/core@10.0.0` depends on `typed-rest-client@2.3.1`, which pins `qs` EXACTLY at `6.15.1`, and GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26 rates `>=6.11.1 <=6.15.1` MODERATE. `ci.yml`'s security-static job runs `pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate`, so the admission turned a merge blocker red on every push. THE OVERRIDE REMOVES THE VULNERABLE PACKAGE RATHER THAN SILENCING THE CHECK, which is the difference between this and raising the audit level: `--audit-level=high` would be weakening a gate to pass it and is refused by the same rule that refused a `.gitleaksignore` fingerprint. It is PATH-SCOPED (`typed-rest-client>qs`) and not global, so a future direct dependant of `qs` gets the version its own manifest asks for and this line does not silently decide for it. `6.15.3` is the advisory's own patched range (`>=6.15.2`) at its latest patch, same major and same minor as the pin it replaces. ADR-127 section 6.
//fast-check: AT THE ROOT FOR scripts/demo's SAKE, and for the same reason `vitest` is here: the demo is deliberately not a workspace package (see its tsconfig), so it has no node_modules of its own and resolves its test-time imports from the root. PT-06 lives in scripts/demo/test because `runDemo` is the only multi-account fold through the real engine in this tree. No package is added that VG-12 has not already admitted: fast-check is in the catalog and is already installed for @merit/rules-engine. NOTE FOR THE NEXT SESSION: this comment sits at the TOP LEVEL and not inside `devDependencies`, where pnpm read a `//`-prefixed key as a real package name and installed it.
